responsibility: Holds the Blackfin target’s common option-processing data and hooks, centered on CPU and silicon-revision selection. The file defines the exported table mapping BF5xx processor names and revisions to backend CPU identifiers and required hardware workarounds, validates and decodes -mcpu forms including revision suffixes, -any, and -none, checks shared-library ID ranges, and stores the resulting CPU type, silicon revision, and workaround mask in gcc_options for later Blackfin code generation decisions.
